title: StellarGlide™ Maintenance Checklist
source: Glice Academy Protocol + stakeholder inputs (FX Live, Andy Wilson)
changelog: v2: añadida lógica condicional para limpieza (sucia? -> restaurada?)
v2: o2 (Glice Care) marcada como pareja obligatoria de o1, no como pregunta independiente
v2: frecuencia de afilado actualizada a 2-4 horas de patinaje (antes: 2 horas)
v2: s3 marcada como acción por evento, condicionada a nuevo campo del Rink Profile

v2.1: removed s1 (sharpen blades reminder) — sharpening is on-request, no routine needed. s2 (check sharpener configuration) is now always shown, independent of rental, since the rink may still own a sharpener for on-request service.
v2.2: re-added s1 (sharpen blades, 2-4h reminder), conditional on offersSkateRental — rental skates need routine sharpening, s2 (configuration check) stays always-on regardless.
v2.3: removed s3 (rental skate return check / event counter) entirely — decided it added confusion without enough value for the prototype.

requiresRinkProfileUpdate.label: Do you offer skate rental?
requiresRinkProfileUpdate.note: Campo nuevo a añadir en Flujo 0 (Rink Profile). Controla si el grupo 'rental' se muestra en el checklist de mantenimiento.

questions.note: Se pregunta cada día como parte del bloque de limpieza. Si 'No', el bloque 'occasional' no se muestra ese día.

questions.text: After cleaning, was the surface restored?
questions.note: Solo aparece si se completó la limpieza húmeda (o1) ese día. Si 'No', se muestra el grupo 'powerwash'.

tasks.name: Dry-brush the entire surface
tasks.note: Use the Glice Activator Brush™. No water, or just a little — do not use the vacuum function. Activates the shear effect for excellent glide.

tasks.name: Cover rink with UV protection when not in use
tasks.note: Apply UV protection cover over the rink whenever it is not in use to protect the surface.

trigger.note: Only relevant if the rink has a UV protection cover, per the Rink Profile.

tasks.name: Wet clean the surface
tasks.note: Kärcher brush + water + Glice Clean, vacuum function ON.

tasks.name: Apply Glice Care after wet cleaning
tasks.note: Wet cleaning dries out the surface. Glice Care restores it. Never skip this step.

trigger.note: Se muestra y marca siempre junto a o1, no depende de una pregunta propia.

groups.label: Power wash — exceptional only
groups.subtitle: Only if wet cleaning is not enough

tasks.name: Power wash the surface
tasks.note: Only when wet cleaning has not restored the surface.

tasks.name: Sharpen blades
tasks.note: For a perfect skating experience, sharpen after every 2-4 hours of skating.

trigger.note: Only relevant for rental skates, which see repeated use across many skaters.

tasks.name: Check sharpener configuration
tasks.note: Confirm the sharpening wheel is correctly centred. Check at least once a day.

tip: Daily brushing also keeps skate blades sharper for longer — saving the Rink Manager time. Want to save time? Brush the rink daily!
